scope: Exactly three Chinese sentence fields and one dictionary character. Preserve the mainline purchase v. and every English, cloze, answer, hint, status and other field.

before.sentenceEn: Choosing which university to attend was a tough decision for most senior high students.
before.sentenceZh: 對大多數高三學生來說，選擇要就讀哪所大學是一個艱難的決定。

after.sentenceZh: 對大多數高中學生來說，選擇要就讀哪所大學是一個艱難的決定。

patches.reason: senior high 是高中階段，不是 high school senior（高中畢業班學生）。現譯把全體高中生限縮成高三；只把「高三」改為「高中」，保留其餘語義與空提示。

before.sentenceEn: Customers who purchase more than three items will receive a ten percent discount at checkout.
before.sentenceZh: 購買三件以上商品的顧客，結帳時可享九折優惠。

after.sentenceZh: 購買超過三件商品的顧客，結帳時可享九折優惠。

patches.reason: more than three items 的數量嚴格大於三；「三件以上」在教學及購物門檻通常包含三件，會把折扣起算量提前一件。最小修正為「超過三件」，保留英文、purchase 答案與九折。

before.sentenceEn: The shelf is low enough for a child to reach.
before.sentenceZh: 這個架子夠低，小孩構得到。

after.sentenceZh: 這個架子夠低，小孩搆得到。

patches.reason: reach 指伸手觸及，現譯構為木部構造之構；教育部原站以手部搆列觸及義。本提案只更換這一字，保留夠低及其餘內容。

before.meaningZh: 乾衣機；乾燥劑；催幹劑；乾燥器

after.meaningZh: 乾衣機；乾燥劑；催乾劑；乾燥器

patches.reason: Only correct the drying-agent character 幹→乾. Retain all four source-supported meanings, existing noun POS and draft status; no optional domain rewrite is adopted.
